method: Map binary 0 and 1 to NRZ amplitudes -1 and +1. The rectangular pulse is one inside |t/T| < 1/2, half at its edges and zero outside. The raised-cosine pulse is sinc(t/T) cos(pi beta t/T) / (1 - (2 beta t/T)^2), with its removable singularities evaluated by their limits and a six-symbol truncation on either side. Sum the shifted pulses, then overlay two-symbol traces centered on each interior symbol's ideal sampling instant. Vertical opening is the lowest nonnegative center level minus the highest negative center level, or N/A when both polarities are not present. Noise, jitter and channel loss are excluded.
